completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Parking Places (Digital Payment — Parking Charges) Rules 2022 and come into operation on 7 February 2022.

chapter.en: PART 2 DIGITAL PAYMENT OF PARKING CHARGES FOR COUPON PARKING PLACES

heading.en: Methods of digital payment of parking charges for coupon parking places

text.en:
3. Without limiting rule 7(1)(a) of the Parking Places Rules (R 2), a person who parks a vehicle for a parking session within a coupon parking place during any period during which parking charges are payable may pay the parking charges for the parking session by the method specified in rule 4 or 4A.
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]

chapter.en: PART 2 DIGITAL PAYMENT OF PARKING CHARGES FOR COUPON PARKING PLACES

heading.en: Paying parking charges for coupon parking places using Parking.sg app

text.en:
4.—(1) A person mentioned in rule 3 may pay the parking charges mentioned in that rule —
(a)first, by entering the following information using the Parking.sg app:
(i)the identification mark of the vehicle;
(ii)the location of the coupon parking place;
(iii)the class of vehicle;
(iv)the duration of the parking session; and
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(b)then, by confirming the payment for the parking session of the vehicle using the Parking.sg app immediately after the parking session begins, and in every case, in advance of the end of that parking session.
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(2) A person may pay for an extension of the duration of a parking session using the Parking.sg app by following the same steps mentioned in paragraph (1) as if the extension were a new parking session.
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(3) A person who has paid the parking charges for a parking session of a vehicle in accordance with this rule may end the parking session of the vehicle prematurely, and if the person also indicates the premature ending using the Parking.sg app, the Superintendent may refund to the person a part of the paid parking charge that is proportionate to the time the vehicle was removed before the expiry of the parking session for which payment was made.
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]

chapter.en: PART 2 DIGITAL PAYMENT OF PARKING CHARGES FOR COUPON PARKING PLACES

heading.en: Paying parking charges for coupon parking places using REP app

text.en:
4A.—(1) A person mentioned in rule 3 may pay the parking charges mentioned in that rule using the REP app by the method described in paragraph (2) or (3).
(2) Where the person has authorised the parking charges to be paid in whole by electronic funds transfer using the person’s credit card or debit card or any other payment facility available for use on the backend payment service account that is registered to the in-vehicle unit of the vehicle, the person may pay the parking charges —
(a)first, by —
(i)triggering a parking prompt at the start of the parking session by —
(A)staying within the coupon parking place for a reasonable period of time; or
(B)tapping on a P icon that is digitally displayed on the in-vehicle unit of the vehicle;
(ii)confirming that the parking prompt correctly displays the coupon parking place within which the vehicle is parked; and
(iii)confirming that the parking session has begun; and
(b)then, by ending the parking session within the coupon parking place.
(3) Where the person has not authorised the parking charges to be paid in whole by electronic funds transfer using the person’s credit card or debit card or any other payment facility available for use on the backend payment service account that is registered to the in-vehicle unit of the vehicle, the person may pay the parking charges —
(a)first, by using the REP app in the manner described in paragraph (2)(a);
(b)then, by inserting a compatible stored-value card into the in-vehicle unit before the vehicle leaves the coupon parking place; and
(c)then, by allowing the parking charges to be paid in whole by electronic funds transfer deducted from the compatible stored-value card when the vehicle leaves the coupon parking place.
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]

chapter.en: PART 3 DIGITAL PAYMENT OF PARKING CHARGES FOR PARKING@HDB PARKING PLACES

heading.en: Methods of digital payment of parking charges for Parking@HDB parking places

text.en:
5.—(1) Without limiting rule 7(1)(b) of the Parking Places Rules, a person who parks a vehicle for a parking session within a Parking@HDB parking place during any period during which parking charges are payable may pay the parking charges for the parking session by —
(a)the method in paragraph (2) or (4) if the person is registered on the Parking@HDB app as the primary driver of the vehicle;
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(b)the method in paragraph (3) or (4) if the person is registered on the Parking@HDB app as a secondary driver of the vehicle; or
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(c)the method in paragraph (4) in any case.
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(2) Where a person who intends to pay a parking charge for a parking session from parking a vehicle in a Parking@HDB parking place is registered on the Parking@HDB app as the primary driver of the vehicle, the person may pay those parking charges —
(a)first, by authorising the parking charge to be paid in whole by electronic funds transfer using the person’s credit card or debit card or any other payment facility available for use on the Parking@HDB app; and
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(b)then, by ending the parking session at the Parking@HDB parking place.
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(3) Where a person who intends to pay a parking charge for a parking session from parking a vehicle in a Parking@HDB parking place is registered on the Parking@HDB app as a secondary driver of the vehicle, the person may pay those parking charges —
(a)first, by authorising the parking charge to be paid in whole by electronic funds transfer using the person’s credit card or debit card or any other payment facility available for use on the Parking@HDB app;
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(b)by indicating on the Parking@HDB app that he or she is the driver, before parking the vehicle in the Parking@HDB parking place; and
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(c)then, by ending the parking session at the Parking@HDB parking place.
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(4) A person who intends to pay a parking charge for a parking session from parking a vehicle in a Parking@HDB parking place may pay those parking charges —
(a)by inserting a compatible stored‑value card into the in‑vehicle unit before the vehicle leaves the Parking@HDB parking place; and
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(b)then, by allowing the parking charge to be paid in whole by electronic funds transfer deducted from the compatible stored‑value card when the vehicle leaves the Parking@HDB parking place.
[S 529/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
6. The Parking Places (Digital Payment — Parking Charges) Rules 2017 (G.N. No. S 553/2017) are revoked.
